text: 1 uL of each plasmid (the paper's low-volume configuration) into the 10 uL of competent cells in the matching transformation-plate well (plasmid A1 to cells A1 and so on) for all 8 plasmids, with the thermocycler block at 4 C while cells are handled.
Run on the thermocycler module as in APEX Protocol 1: 4 C for 30 min with DNA, then 42 C for 30 s, lid closed (a short return to 4 C afterwards passes).
50 uL SOC (low-volume configuration) added to each transformation after the heat shock, then recovery at 37 C for 1 h on the thermocycler module.
Never pipettes without a tip and drops every tip by the end. A fresh tip for every plasmid, and no tip that has touched one transformation touches another or goes back into a stock.

Implements the paper's method on the given deck with no missing, invented or reordered steps; volumes, times, temperatures and reagents match the paper, or are a sound adaptation where the given deck or reagents force one; comments and metadata (including any citation) are accurate.
